firm_data.firm_description: Friedman Vartolo, founded in 2016, provides tailored legal services to lenders, servicers, and property owners across multiple states. The firm focuses on collaboration, innovation, and diligence to deliver these services.
notable_facts: Provides services in Connecticut, Florida, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania.
Offers boutique attention with big-firm capacity.

email.subject: AI for Friedman Vartolo, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Adam,

Friedman Vartolo's footprint across foreclosure, litigation, and bankruptcy work in seven states caught my attention, especially given how document-heavy those practices are. Since 2016, you've built something rare: boutique attention with big-firm capacity.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're arriving in New York next week. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
